title: Layered circuit associated to a tree circuit
statement: Let $c$ be a tree Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits. Define its associated layered Boolean circuit by first converting it to a directed acyclic graph circuit using De Morgan transformations, then converting that graph circuit to a layered circuit with the same input bits and a single output.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a tree circuit with $n$ input bits
